proposed_fix.description: Temporarily increase outbound timeout limits or enable an async fallback for emailservice until downstream dependency latency normalizes.
steps: [GATE] On-call engineer reviews trace data to identify the specific downstream dependency causing the 57.79x inbound call latency spike.
[ACTION] If the dependency is temporarily degraded, apply a temporary ConfigMap override to increase emailservice.outbound_timeout to 2000ms.
[GATE] On-call verifies emailservice_latency-90 metrics stabilize below baseline for 5 minutes; if latency persists, proceed to fallback.
[ACTION] Enable the emailservice.async_fallback feature flag to bypass synchronous dependency calls.
preconditions: Verify current emailservice.outbound_timeout value and async_fallback flag state in the live environment.
Confirm on-call has explicit approval to modify runtime configuration or feature flags.
Ensure latency dashboards are actively streaming to validate the fix.
proposed_fix.rollback: Revert the ConfigMap timeout to its original value and disable the async_fallback feature flag; restart emailservice pods if hot-reload is unavailable.
